abstract_sentences.text: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and its variants have substantially improved the performance of language models on complex reasoning tasks, yet the precise mechanisms by which different strategies facilitate generalization remain poorly understood.

While current explanations often point to increased test-time computation or structural guidance, establishing a consistent, quantifiable link between these factors and generalization remains challenging.
In this work, we identify intrinsic dimensionality as a quantitative measure for characterizing the effectiveness of reasoning chains.

evidence.anchor: identify intrinsic dimensionality as a quantitative measure

abstract_sentences.text: Intrinsic dimensionality quantifies the minimum number of model dimensions needed to reach a given accuracy threshold on a given task.

By keeping the model architecture fixed and varying the task formulation through different reasoning strategies, we demonstrate that effective reasoning strategies consistently reduce the intrinsic dimensionality of the task.

Validating this on GSM8K with Gemma-3 1B and 4B, we observe a strong inverse correlation between the intrinsic dimensionality of a reasoning strategy and its generalization performance on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data.
Our findings suggest that effective reasoning chains facilitate learning by better compressing the task using fewer parameters, offering a new quantitative metric for analyzing reasoning processes.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 固定学生模型与问题源，仅改变 reasoning-chain supervision；用 LoRA trainable-parameter sweep 找达到共同 accuracy threshold 的最小 dint，再检验其对 held-out generalization 的预测力。有效链条被解释为更容易压缩的 task mapping。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 dint 定义、LoRA 参数公式、common-threshold 理由、14-strategy 的 1B/4B 主表、Figure 2、threshold robustness、correctness mix、Reasoning Gym transfer 与 PPL/KL/length 对照，足以重建比较逻辑。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载 greedy LoRA configuration、收敛/学习率 sweep、GSM8K/Reasoning Gym split details、LongPPL、策略样例和逐 split Tables 8–9；主结论自足，但替代解释与 OOD 异质性需要附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 画出 strategy→adapter sweep→ID/OOD 路径，Figure 2/3 用共同阈值和 Pareto frontier 把抽象 ID 映射为 crossing，Tables 1/2 把效果和 baseline metrics 并置。
final_judgment.largest_gap: strategy-level correlation 被当作 compression mechanism 的主要证据，因果识别、直接 compression measure、seed/hardware 波动和跨 PEFT 一致性仍缺失；实践 guidance 只有 implication。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 比较多种输出/推理策略时，固定模型和问题源，预先规定跨策略共同 capability threshold，同时报告 capacity sweep、held-out generalization 和 length/likelihood confounders。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适用于同一任务、模型家族和 fine-tuning/PEFT 框架内的相对 strategy comparison。LoRA ID 是 upper-bound-like operational proxy，不能直接等同于 Kolmogorov complexity；有限的 GSM8K/Reasoning Gym 与两种 Gemma 规模限制外推。
